change: Model-defect fixes from the Phase A decomposition, applied together because they all change the comparison between architectures: (MD-7) capacity above a site's day-zero scale is an expansion and becomes available only after the new global parameter capacity_expansion_days, with the opt-in design variable instant_expansion restoring the previous behaviour; (MD-6) fixed site operations accrue only while a site exists, while capital and validation stay sunk from day zero, and backlog still inside its backorder window at the end of the measured horizon is reported as open_backlog_units_at_horizon rather than counted lost; (MD-4) opening stock is seeded as four shelf-life cohorts spread from one replenishment cycle to full shelf life instead of all at half shelf life; (MD-14) a reserved line Telo does not own carries no annualized capital, fixed operations, or validation, only its reservation fee, with the new design variable reserved_site_owned for a standby line Telo builds
rationale: The protocol's fair-comparison rule requires commissioning lead time to be counted for capacity that does not exist at t0, and capacity_factor was exempting expansions from it while new sites paid 730 days. The protocol's cost boundary forbids double counting, and a reserved line was charged as an owned asset and then charged a reservation fee on top. Opening stock stamped at half a 24-month shelf life expired on day 365, the first measured day, which made larger safety stock read as harmful and invalidated the optimizer's safety-stock conclusions. Measured effect on the frozen snapshot: 12 of 32 event digests and 20 of 32 costs change; sodium bicarbonate S4 loses 0.171 fill in run 0 and S3 costs fall about 40%

section: disruptions; deterministic screen; cost ledger; strategies; regulatory_gates
change: Verification-pass corrections to the Phase D configuration and to three engine defects it exposed. ENGINE. (MD-19) A supplier's daily capacity is a fraction, not a switch: shipment used to be gated on capacity > 0, while a common-cause group sets its members to 1 - impact with impact drawn from a Beta of mean 0.5, so a group declared on a supplier could never delay a unit at any parameter value. A supplier at fraction f now ships at most f of one full order per day, the same proportional time stretch a degraded production line already applied. (MD-20) The deterministic screen dropped every reserved site from saleable capacity and charged no reservation fee for a declared topology, so S11, S13, S16, S17 and S19 screened byte-identical to S0; a reserved line now contributes its exercise duty cycle to capacity and its reservation fee plus take-or-pay to cost, and cmd_deterministic, ablation and backcast were switched from load_strategies to load_all_strategies so Phase D's screening and ablation batteries see S8-S19 at all. (MD-21) The reservation fee and the take-or-pay commitment now accrue only while the reserved site exists, extending the R005 rule for fixed site operations. CONFIGURATION (config/strategies/design_space.yaml). cc_stopper_1 is declared on every site plan of all twelve designs (every site draws stopper_1 and no design declared any container-closure group); cc_geo_<region_id> is declared on every site plan in its region, one convention instead of five; cc_quality is added to S9, S10, S11, S14 and S19, each of which omitted it on a separate-legal-entities or own-registration rationale while its own regulatory_owner placed every site under one application whose holder's quality unit performs the non-delegable disposition; take_or_pay_fraction is removed from the S11 and S13 search blocks and replaced by a variable with a service channel, because it enters only the cost ledger and a cost-minimising optimizer removes it (MD-24); the inert design variable sites: 2.0 is deleted from S11; S10's falsification test is restated as an internal single-host control, because the anchor-tenancy sibling it named is configured nowhere. GATES. Added G16 (component and container-closure lot qualification under 21 CFR 211.84 and 211.94, plus the Type II DMF letter of authorisation the alternate API source must issue, F9-S12), status UNCERTAIN, no reviewer, applying to S9, S18 and S19. DOCUMENTATION. MD-19 to MD-25 added to bottleneck_decomposition.md section 7; two dangling source ids corrected in novel_architectures.md (LCDM-S07 -> LCDM-S7, LCDM-S02 -> LCDM-S2); the Emergent capacity-reservation attribution corrected in novel_architectures.md and landscape/cdmos.md (F7-S04 is the CIADM task order, and the CIADM site is not the Camden merchant fill-finish site that was sold); a Phlow profitability note in morphological_matrix.csv given its actual source (LNPM-S09) and its forward-looking qualifier restored; pre-R004 vintage labels added to eight run-derived cells in morphological_matrix.csv and to the Phase A cost shares carried into novel_architectures.md; every unregistered scoping number in novel_architectures.md marked at its point of use; falsification_register.csv row count corrected in R006's own text and the S14 Leiters row restated as indirect counter-evidence with the caveat its source carries.
rationale: Three of the corrections are prohibition-level. Declaring cc_quality where one quality unit disposes batches from several sites is required by the rule that nominally separate sites share the common-cause groups they really share; five designs asserted independence their own regulatory-owner field denied. Declaring cc_stopper_1 removes a shared hazard that was absent from all twelve tails while four designs described it in prose. The deterministic screen was publishing contracted-capacity architectures as though they were the status quo, which is a hidden-tail-risk and a cost-boundary error at once. The remaining items are comparability and traceability: group count is not neutral because every declared group draws its own Poisson stream, so one convention had to replace five; and a numeric claim without a vintage or a manifest cannot be traced to a configuration and a seed. Measured effects. Frozen S0-S7 service is unchanged: no event digest and no fill rate moves, because the supplier fix behaves exactly as before at full and at zero capacity and S3's reserved line exists at t0. Twelve of the thirty-two frozen costs move, the largest by 8.6e-7 relative (S0 norepinephrine run 1, 12,469,383.06 -> 12,469,376.48 USD/yr), because a partly shipped order spends a day in transit rather than in stock and the material carrying-cost integral moves with it; tests/regression/frozen_digests_s0_s7.json was re-captured with the pre-R007 values kept in each entry. On the deterministic screen, sodium bicarbonate now separates the contracted designs from S0 (utilization 1.105 for S11, 1.148 for S16, 0.993 for S17 and 1.194 for S19 against S0's 1.245, with reservation cost 2.13M, 4.85M, 4.68M and 2.95M USD/yr). Every stochastic run of S8-S19 made before 2026-09-03 is superseded, because the group counts changed. Two measurements recorded from the pass itself, both n = 25 paired on sodium bicarbonate: the S16 exercise ablation moves fill +0.00163, inside its own MCSE of 0.0036, while the same ablation on S17 moves +0.01070 with p_meet 0.92 -> 0.48 (MD-23); and S9's matched-membership control returns 0.997733 in both arms after the MD-19 fix, so that null is a property of network slack and the hazard rate rather than of the gate. Adding gate G16 can only make a strategy less eligible, never more, and no gate status changes.

change: Model defect MD-17 (renumbered from R006, which the design-space configuration stage had already taken). A site that does not exist at t0 now starts its commissioning clock at the first measured day (SimSettings.commissioning_from_measurement_start, default true) instead of at simulation day zero, and capacity_expansion_days moves from 365 to 270 days. Every run now reports capacity_days_lost_to_commissioning_fraction, the capacity-weighted share of the measured window during which a durable site did not exist.
rationale: Three commissioning-family parameters (capacity_expansion_days 365, second_source_qualification_days 365, and the low bound of node_commissioning_days 365) coincided with warm_up_days 365, so any lead time at or below a year was served entirely by the warm-up period and cost nothing inside the window the metrics cover. The R004 expansion lever was therefore inert at its own base. Measured effect on sodium bicarbonate at the baseline designs, one run at seed 20260901: S2 window loss 0.000 to 0.100 and fill 0.990 to 0.917, S4 0.100 to 0.200 and 0.947 to 0.889, S5 and S6 0.144 to 0.287 and 0.912 to 0.857. The strategy that benefited most from the artifact was dual sourcing, which is the one the session-1 threshold sensitivity had found feasible.

change: Model defect NEW-1. Opening inventory is purchased, not inherited: the units seeded at every region and site on day zero are charged once at the same unit value production pays (variable materials plus conversion) into a new CostLedger field opening_inventory, and the ledger horizon scaling spreads the lump across the measured window. The carrying cost of that position is not added, because inventory_logistics already values the whole book including these lots and charging it twice would double count.
rationale: A feasibility study asking whether to build a network must pay for the position it starts with. Opening stock was free and its quantity scaled with the design own stock policy, so a design whose optimum is a year of safety stock was handed that year for nothing. On sodium bicarbonate the opening position covers about five years of the network structural capacity gap inside a five-year window, so no comparison between a deep-stock design and a capacity design was sound.
author: Rikhin Kavuru (agent-assisted; session 2)

change: Model defects MD-3, MD-12 and MD-11. Every frozen comparator now searches the same inventory space the design-space strategies declare for themselves: safety_stock_days 30 to 365, region_base_stock as a binary, site_fg_days and material_target_days. The previous spaces are kept as LEGACY_DESIGN_SPACES so earlier runs remain reproducible. The infeasible tie-break now ranks on fill only where the difference exceeds a noise band derived from the screen size, then on cost, and the band is recorded on the optimization record.
rationale: A comparison run across unequal search boxes measures the box and not the architecture. The matched-space check of 2026-09-05 measured what the gap was worth: added central capacity moved from infeasible to feasible on both products at roughly 60 percent of its declared-space cost. Separately the tie-break had bought a 9.26M USD per year cost increase for 0.00004 of fill, about 0.02 of one standard error, because it ranked on raw fill with no tolerance on a 20-run screen whose binomial standard error at q is 0.067.

section: material policy; allocation; readiness and contract channels
change: Model defects MD-1, NEW-2, MD-23 and MD-24. The material policy separates pipeline cover (lead-time demand) from policy cover (safety plus cycle), and the opening component position is the policy position and no longer tracks the lead. Regions may carry differing criticality weights and minimum guarantees through default_regions(criticality_spread, minimum_guarantee_fraction), both defaulting to the identical-region base case, and the minimum guarantee is passed to the allocator. Any batch restarts the readiness clock on a reserved line, and a take-or-pay commitment orders committed lines ahead of uncommitted ones in a region sourcing list.
rationale: MD-1: both the order-up-to level and the opening position scaled with the lead, so a supplier promising faster resupply left the site holding less and the two lead-time ablation factors carried the wrong sign in 13 and 14 of 16 cells. NEW-2: with every region at weight 1.0 and no guarantee, three of the four allocation policies are arithmetically the same function, so allocation rights could not be measured; the plumbing now permits a difference and the default asserts none, because no evidence in this package says regions differ (HA-20, HA-33). MD-23: readiness is time since the last qualified batch, so a campaign batch must requalify the line. MD-24: a volume commitment had no service channel at all, so any optimizer choosing on cost drove it to its lower bound.
author: Rikhin Kavuru (agent-assisted; session 2)

change: Model defect MD-25, in the protocol rather than the engine. A seventh interview role, purchaser_contracting_authority, is added at min 3 and max 4, and the evidence log schema gains the matching role enum. Role minima now sum to 25 and role maxima to 33, so the declared total_target of [25, 30] is reachable at both ends.
rationale: The six declared roles had maxima summing to 29, one short of the declared total ceiling of 30, so the protocol could not be satisfied at its own upper bound without breaking a role cap. Separately, every architecture this study found feasible is bought rather than built, which makes the person who signs a volume commitment the binding decision maker; no declared role covered that person. The governing assignment asks for 12 to 20 interviews and this protocol asks for 25 to 30; the protocol is the stricter and governs. No interview has taken place, so no evidence is affected.
